name: What is the average cost of window replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window replacement varies widely based on factors such as window type (e.g., vinyl, wood, fiberglass), style (e.g., casement, double-hung, picture), size, glass options, and installation complexity. While a precise quote requires an on-site evaluation, homeowners can expect to invest anywhere from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window. We provide detailed, transparent estimates tailored to your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window replacement costs vary by type, style, size, and installation complexity. Expect prices ranging from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars per window.
